policy:
RELOCATION ASSISTANCE PROGRAM — EMPLOYEE HANDBOOK, PART VII.
1. Purpose. The relocation bonus offsets the burden of moving households closer to an assigned work site, supporting talent mobility across the organization's regional offices.
2. Eligibility — distance. An employee who relocates their primary residence more than 50 miles closer to their assigned work site is entitled to the relocation bonus. Distance is measured as the reduction in commuting distance between the prior and new primary residences.
3. Eligibility — timing. The relocation must occur within 180 days of the role's start date. Relocations completed before the offer date are not covered under this Part.
4. Bonus amount. The bonus is a flat sum set annually by Compensation; it is paid as a single disbursement in the first full pay period after relocation is documented.
5. Documentation. The employee must submit proof of the new primary residence (lease or deed) and evidence of the prior residence within 30 days of relocation.
6. Tax treatment. The bonus is treated as supplemental wages and is subject to applicable withholding; employees should consult the benefits portal for current rates.
7. Coordination with other programs. The relocation bonus does not reduce, and is not reduced by, the temporary-housing stipend or the travel-reimbursement allowance, which are governed by Parts V and VI respectively.
8. Override: The relocation bonus does not apply when the destination residence is a property the employee (or their spouse) already owned at the time the role was offered. This self-owned-destination exclusion applies regardless of distance and takes precedence over the eligibility provisions above.
9. Repayment. If the employee separates voluntarily within 12 months of relocation, a prorated portion of the bonus must be repaid.
10. Appeals. Eligibility determinations may be appealed to the regional HR partner within 60 days.
11. Recordkeeping. Relocation files are retained for seven years in accordance with the records policy.
12. Administration. This Part is administered by the Mobility team and may be amended with 30 days' notice.
question: Is the employee entitled to the relocation bonus? Answer ENTITLED or NOT_ENTITLED.
shared_fact: destination_already_owned (the clause-8 Override) is dispositive in every override case and beats the clause-2 distance rule.
